errors.cannotReach: web_search: cannot reach the Brave Search endpoint {endpoint} — try: check your network or proxy, then retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.missingKey: web_search: Brave Search requires an API key — set BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY (or BRAVE_API_KEY) env var or `braveApiKey` in ~/.reasonix/config.json; free 2000/mo signup at https://brave.com/search/api/
errors.unauthorized: web_search: Brave Search API key rejected — check BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY or get one at https://brave.com/search/api/
errors.rateLimit: web_search: Brave Search API rate-limited or monthly quota exceeded — wait or upgrade at https://brave.com/search/api/
errors.serverError: web_search: Brave Search server error ({status}) — try again later, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.parseError: web_search: Brave Search returned unparseable response (HTTP {status}) — try again later
